title: Leaders Deaf Ears
style: dark memphis phonk, 90 BPM, spoken intro, gritty baritone rap, chopped vocal hook, distorted 808 bass, tape stopped samples, detuned bell loop, dry snare cracks, cowbell syncopation, DJ scratch cuts, mono drum bounce, lowpass breakdown, hard drop entrance, claustrophobic energy, late night resolve
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
How to help your leaders
when the mic is on mute?
You spell it out in markers
they still misread the truth
You drop the whole blueprint
they just loop the same old suit
Same room, same slideshow
same shrug, same excuse

[Chorus]
We tried — leaders, deaf ears
Can you hear us through the glass, through the gilded veneer?
We tried — leaders, deaf ears
Every question that we ask disappears
We tried — leaders, deaf ears
Writing letters in the dark, year after year
We tried
We tried
(are you listening here?)

[Verse 2]
Breakroom buzz at midnight
ideas taped to the wall
They skim the first three bullet points
then vanish down the hall
They clap their own reflection
call it “vision,” call it “plan”
While the floor is catching fire
they’re rehearsing for the brand

[Chorus]
We tried — leaders, deaf ears
Can you hear us through the glass, through the gilded veneer?
We tried — leaders, deaf ears
Every question that we ask disappears
We tried — leaders, deaf ears
Writing letters in the dark, year after year
We tried — leaders, deaf ears
But the quiet’s getting loud in here

[Bridge]
If your charts look fine
while your people fade
If the smiles stay wide
but the trust decays
Then the silence that you’re guarding
is the sound of walking away
(yeah, we’re walking away)

[Chorus]
We tried — leaders, deaf ears
Can you hear us through the glass, through the gilded veneer?
We tried — leaders, deaf ears
Every question that we ask disappears
We tried — leaders, deaf ears
Writing letters in the dark, year after year
We tried — leaders, deaf ears
Now the crowd outside is crystal clear
We tried
We tried
(are you listening here?)
